headline: Keefe, Bruyette & Woods Maintains Market Perform on The Hartford Insurance Gr, Raises Price Target to $144
summary: Keefe, Bruyette & Woods  analyst Meyer Shields   maintains The Hartford Insurance Gr (NYSE:HIG) with a Market Perform and raises the price target from $143 to $144.
